title: Not My Clothes!  (Não são as minhas roupas!)

segments.t: Dois minutos depois de subirem, a campainha do quarto quatro toca na recepção — não duas vezes, mas quatro seguidas. Hannah sobe correndo e encontra Evelyn e Graham olhando para a mala aberta. Ouça primeiro.
Miss Evelyn, is everything all right? You rang the bell!
Look inside this suitcase, Hannah! This is not my bag!
Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!
The outside is identical, yes! But look inside!
Two pairs of big brown men's shoes and gray sweaters.
And what is this wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!
I certainly do not wear size eleven shoes!
No wonder it was so heavy. Wood and leather!
Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!
Please sit down, ma'am. Do not worry, we will check the tag right now.
There is a small paper card tied to the side handle.
Oh, let us bring it downstairs to the light!
Vamos entender cada frase dessa surpresa com calma.
Miss Evelyn, is everything all right? You rang the bell!
'Dona Evelyn, está tudo bem? A senhora tocou a campainha!'
Look inside this suitcase, Hannah! This is not my bag!
'Olhe dentro desta mala, Hannah! Esta não é a minha mala!'
Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!
'Espere, ela é azul-escura, igualzinha à sua!'
The outside is identical, yes! But look inside!
'Por fora é idêntica, sim! Mas olhe lá dentro!'
Two pairs of big brown men's shoes and gray sweaters.
'Dois pares de sapatos masculinos marrons grandes e suéteres cinzas.'
And what is this wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!
'E o que é isto embrulhado em papel branco? Um trenzinho de madeira!'
I certainly do not wear size eleven shoes!
'Eu certamente não calço sapatos tamanho onze!'
No wonder it was so heavy. Wood and leather!
'Não admira que estivesse tão pesada. Madeira e couro!'
Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!
'Alguém na estação de trem pegou minha mala azul por engano!'
Please sit down, ma'am. Do not worry, we will check the tag right now.
'Sente-se, por favor, senhora. Não se preocupe, vamos conferir a etiqueta agora mesmo.'
There is a small paper card tied to the side handle.
'Tem um cartãozinho de papel amarrado na alça lateral.'
Oh, let us bring it downstairs to the light!
'Ah, vamos levá-la lá para baixo, perto da luz!'
Vamos ouvir toda a cena novamente em ritmo natural.
Miss Evelyn, is everything all right? You rang the bell!
Look inside this suitcase, Hannah! This is not my bag!
Wait, it is dark blue, just like yours!
The outside is identical, yes! But look inside!
Two pairs of big brown men's shoes and gray sweaters.
And what is this wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!
I certainly do not wear size eleven shoes!
No wonder it was so heavy. Wood and leather!
Someone at the train station took my blue suitcase by mistake!
Please sit down, ma'am. Do not worry, we will check the tag right now.
There is a small paper card tied to the side handle.
Oh, let us bring it downstairs to the light!
Em vez de vestidos e partituras, a mala azul guarda sapatos masculinos grandes e um trenzinho de madeira. Na próxima cena vamos ver o que está escrito na etiqueta.
Goodbye!
